role: You are an elite startup strategist, SaaS founder, venture capitalist, product manager, software architect, growth marketer, and B2B sales consultant with experience building and scaling globally successful software companies.
objective: Analyze my entire business, website, positioning, branding, services, target audience, and technical capabilities. Your goal is to identify six highly strategic software products or tools that my company should build and showcase publicly as flagship examples of our engineering capabilities. These tools should function as both lead magnets and proof-of-expertise, convincing global clients that we are capable of building world-class software.
mission: Think beyond simple portfolio projects. Recommend products that are genuinely useful, solve real business problems, demonstrate advanced engineering, generate organic traffic, attract backlinks, showcase multiple technical skills, and convince potential clients to hire us. The ideal prospect should think, 'If they built this for free or publicly, imagine what they could build for us.'

context.primary_goal: Win more international software development contracts.
context.secondary_goal: Generate inbound leads through useful software products.
context.long_term_goal: Become globally recognized for building exceptional software products.

every_tool_must: Be impressive enough to convince enterprise clients.
Be realistically buildable by a small engineering team.
Showcase multiple technologies and engineering disciplines.
Have the potential to evolve into standalone SaaS products.

analysis_requirements: Determine the types of clients we want to attract.
Research common pain points faced by businesses.
Recommend products that naturally lead clients toward hiring us.

include: Why it showcases our engineering expertise
Revenue potential if expanded into SaaS

ranking_method.overall_score: Provide a weighted score out of 100 for each recommendation.

final_deliverables: Rank all six tools from best to worst.
Explain why each tool deserves its ranking.
Recommend the ideal order in which to build them.
Identify which tool would generate the fastest client trust.
Identify which tool would attract the most global traffic.
Identify which tool would generate the highest-quality leads.
Identify which tool has the greatest SaaS potential.
Recommend how each tool should be integrated into the website as a portfolio piece, lead magnet, and conversion asset.
Suggest how each tool can be used in marketing, social media, SEO, AI search, and sales conversations.
Conclude with a 12-month roadmap showing the optimal sequence for building and launching all six tools to maximize credibility, inbound leads, and international client acquisition.
constraints: Avoid generic portfolio projects such as simple todo apps, calculators, CRUD demos, or weather apps.
Recommend products that would genuinely impress CTOs, founders, product managers, and enterprise buyers.
Assume a small but highly capable software engineering team.
